name: Cascade Biotech Substrate Containment Suit
description:
A specialized containment suit designed for handling active substrate materials that exhibit unpredictable biological behavior. The suit's exterior is coated with a substrate-repellent compound that prevents biological agents from bonding to the surface. Internal monitoring systems alert the wearer if any substrate material penetrates the barrier.

Unique to Synthesis Collective and Cascade Biotech facilities where substrate research pushes into territory that conventional hazmat equipment can't address. The suit is designed for threats that are alive, adaptive, and actively trying to find a way through.
functionality: Active substrate containment, breach detection, bio-bonding prevention
what_it_says: Whatever you're handling is alive, it wants out, and this suit is the argument against that.
story_hooks: A Substrate Containment Suit's breach-detection system activates inside a storage room that should contain no active substrate — something in that room has woken up.
